subject.title: [Feature] Allow configuring Gemini safety settings in OpenClaw

question: Should OpenClaw expose configurable Google Generative AI safety thresholds, and what supported scope and default policy should that contract guarantee?
rationale: This creates a new provider configuration surface that can relax an upstream safety control; implementation details cannot decide its product and security posture safely.

options.title: Sponsor a constrained Google-provider contract
options.body: Support only documented Google categories and thresholds, preserve explicit request payload values, and require focused config/runtime documentation and tests.

options.title: Keep Google defaults fixed
options.body: Do not add a core override surface; document the provider’s existing behavior and supported alternatives instead.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a constrained Google-provider contract
recommendation.body: Support only documented Google categories and thresholds, preserve explicit request payload values, and require focused config/runtime documentation and tests.
